visual.general_description: Colour photograph of an excised bowel specimen and a separate round dark red mass on a green drape beside two metal rulers, with blue labelled arrows.
visual.detailed_description: Portrait-orientation colour photograph on a teal-green surgical drape. A horizontal metal ruler along the top shows numbers 1 to 12 and a vertical metal ruler lies along the left edge. A long pink-orange bowel segment with a ruffled wall and attached orange mesenteric fat curves from the lower left upward and to the right, ending in a smoother pink tube at the bottom. A separate round, smooth-surfaced dark red mass lies to the right of the bowel on the drape. Blue rectangular text boxes with arrows are overlaid: Hepatic Flexure and Ascending colon growth at the left, Ileo-colic Pedicle at the center-bottom, Terminal Ileum at the bottom right and Left Adrenal lipoma at the right pointing to the dark red mass. Dark wet marks stain the drape around the specimens.

visual.general_description: Pink and purple stained microscopy image of branching glandular structures lined by dense purple cells separated by pink fibrous bands.
visual.detailed_description: Landscape-orientation microscopy image of tissue stained pink and purple. Elongated, branching and curved glandular or tubular structures made of crowded dark purple nuclei and pink cytoplasm surround narrow pale or white lumina. Bands of pink fibrous tissue with thin spindle nuclei run between and around the purple structures, most obviously in a vertical band at the center-left and a diagonal band at the upper right. A few small round clear spaces lie within some purple structures. A very small yellow mark is at the bottom right corner and is not legible. No scale bar, labels or arrows are visible.
